name: 2_material_summary
summary: Pick a recipe and a quantity to produce, and get the fully recursive flat list of base materials needed.
description: Core use case: given a target recipe (e.g. Acolyte II drones) and a desired output quantity, recursively explode the recipe tree down through all intermediate tiers (T2 components, PI P3/P2/P1 products, reaction chain products) to a flat summary of root base materials (e.g. minerals like Tritanium, and other non-decomposable inputs). Must correctly handle batch sizes/yields that aren't 1:1 (e.g. 10000-unit reaction batches, 5-unit PI outputs). Done when the flat total for a multi-tier recipe like Acolyte II drones is computed correctly.

key_decisions.decision: Selection UI flow: pick an item first. Only if that item has more than one recipe (final products can, per the 1_recipe_management data model) does a second dropdown appear listing the recipe variants (e.g. by variant_label such as decryptor used). The material summary calculation is then run against the selected recipe_id, not just the item_id.
key_decisions.rationale: Final products (is_final_product = true) can have multiple recipes (e.g. different decryptors used in invention), each with its own inputs/output_quantity, so the calculation needs an unambiguous recipe to expand rather than just an item.

key_decisions.decision: BOM explosion runs in the PHP backend, not the Angular frontend (revises the original architecture decision - see project.json). The frontend calls an endpoint like 'explode recipe 123 x30 runs' and gets back the material breakdown.
key_decisions.rationale: Doing this client-side would require the frontend to hold the entire recipe graph in memory. The backend already owns that graph relationally and can walk it directly, returning just the result. Keeps 4_hangar_netting's future netting logic consistent with where explosion lives.

key_decisions.decision: Leftover/excess intermediate quantities from batch-size rounding (e.g. a reaction batch of 10000 Tungsten Carbide when only a few hundred are needed downstream) are computed and surfaced per intermediate tier, not just the flat base-material totals. This applies mainly to reactions - PI recipes always consume in exact multiples of the prior tier's output so leftovers aren't expected there in practice.
key_decisions.rationale: User wants this visible now because it will matter for a future profitability calculator (excess product has value/cost implications). Explicitly distinct from 4_hangar_netting: leftovers here come from batch-size rounding during explosion of a single calculation, not from materials already owned in the hangar - the two won't be conflated.

key_decisions.decision: The fractional per-run reaction quantity rounding issue is explicitly out of scope for this goal - tracked in .claude/FUTURE_IMPROVEMENTS.md instead.
key_decisions.rationale: User declared it not a big deal for now; current integer round-up-per-run values are accepted as-is so this goal isn't blocked on a schema/precision change.
